rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'Direction cosines are arbitrary' ✅ Direction cosines l, m, n are *fixed* values for a given vector: l = cos α, m = cos β, n = cos γ.  ·  ❌ 'Sum of direction ratios is always 1' ✅ The sum of the *squares* of direction *cosines* (l² + m² + n²) equals 1; direction *ratios* do not have this constraint.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: ❌ 'Direction ratios and cosines are the same' ✅ Direction ratios (a, b, c) are proportional to direction cosines (l, m, n), not equal.
